title: Wooden Crucifix ✞
description: A remodel of Minecraft totem of undying!
body:
# ☁️ Resource pack includes custom model of _totem of undying_, replacing it with an old wooden crucifix! ☨
**-  Reference image:**
  
  ![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f3a22babfe435fe0fd4b2ee54f5730fdf716f8c.jpeg)
## ⚙️ Supports:
- 1.11 - 1.21.10 Version of Java Minecraft.
- Does NOT conflict with any resource packs(unless the pack related to the totem itself).
- Includes custom texture.
- In future updates will have it own sound and perhaps retexture.



### 🎨 Installation guide:
- 1️⃣ Download the .zip resource pack 📥

- 2️⃣ Open Minecraft → Options ⚙️ → Resource Packs → Open Pack Folder 📂

- 3️⃣ Put the .zip file there (don’t unzip ❌)

- 4️⃣ Enable it in-game ✅ → Done ✔️
  
- Download Guide▶️:[Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_MZ0_bIgRNg)
